question: All of the following are true about Nizatidine except

options.opa: It is a H2 blocker used in peptic ulcer disease
options.opd: It can also lead to tachycardia

analysis: Nizatidine is a H2 blocker used in peptic ulcer disease, it does not have 100% bioavailability, it does not enhance gastric emptying, and it is not known to lead to tachycardia.
